fields.label: Introduction
fields.text: A traceable review of the fictional Atlas project.

fields.label: Context & problem
fields.text: Support currently prepares account exports manually. Customers need a repeatable way to retrieve their own records.

fields.label: Selected solution
fields.text: Offer CSV export from the account workspace.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.text: A focused self-service flow addresses a recurring request without introducing a reporting platform.

fields.label: Alternatives
fields.text:
Keep support-assisted exports
Advantages: No implementation effort.
Trade-offs: Continued wait time and support effort.

Add self-service CSV export
Advantages: Customers can retrieve records directly.
Trade-offs: Requires access-control and failure handling.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.text: The existing account model defines the accessible record scope.

fields.label: Constraints
fields.text: No changes to the authorization model in this release.

fields.label: Original story
fields.text: As an account administrator, I want to export my account records easily, so that I can prepare internal reports.

fields.label: User story
fields.text: As an account administrator, I want to export my account records easily, so that I can prepare internal reports.

fields.label: Need
fields.text: Export the records available in my account workspace.

fields.label: User value
fields.text: Prepare internal reporting without waiting for support.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.text: Given an authenticated account administrator with accessible records, when they request a CSV export, then a CSV file containing those records is downloaded.

fields.label: Open questions
fields.text:
“easily” is subjective and does not define an observable threshold. What observable condition would demonstrate “easily”? Agree on a measurable expectation.
No error condition is mentioned in the story or criteria. Which failure conditions are relevant here, and what feedback should the user receive?
The empty-data case is not described. What should happen when there are no data to export?

fields.label: Business rules
fields.text: Apply the existing account access permissions.

fields.label: Constraints
fields.text: CSV only for the first release.

fields.label: Dependencies
